name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-23, at wavelengths from 1.20 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
